quickSummary: Lipids are hydrophobic biomolecules soluble in non-polar organic solvents. Saturated fatty acids (Palmitic 16:0) have no double bonds and higher melting points; unsaturated fatty acids (Arachidonic 20:4) have cis double bonds. Essential fatty acids include Linoleic (18:2) and Linolenic (18:3). Triglycerides are glycerol esters with 3 fatty acids. Lecithin is a membrane phospholipid with glycerol, 2 fatty acids, phosphate, and choline. Cholesterol contains a 17-carbon fused CPPP ring modulating fluidity and steroid hormone synthesis.

conceptBreakdown.content:
Lipids are water-insoluble, hydrophobic organic compounds soluble in organic solvents (ether, chloroform, benzene).

### Fatty Acid Saturation & Notation ($C:D^\Delta$)
• **Saturated Fatty Acids**: No double bonds; tightly packed, higher melting points (solid at room temperature):
  - **Palmitic Acid**: 16 carbons ($16:0$).
  - **Stearic Acid**: 18 carbons ($18:0$).
• **Unsaturated Fatty Acids**: Contain one or more *cis* double bonds; lower melting points (oils):
  - **Oleic Acid**: 18 carbons, 1 double bond ($18:1^{\Delta 9}$).
  - **Arachidonic Acid**: 20 carbons, 4 double bonds ($20:4^{\Delta 5,8,11,14}$); precursor for prostaglandins and leukotrienes.
• **Essential Fatty Acids (EFAs)**: Cannot be synthesized by humans; must be obtained from diet:
  1. **Linoleic Acid** ($18:2^{\Delta 9,12}$ — $\omega$-6).
  2. **Linolenic Acid** ($18:3^{\Delta 9,12,15}$ — $\omega$-3).

LECITHIN MOLECULAR ARCHITECTURE
                           
    [ Glycerol Backbone ] ──► Esters to 2 Fatty Acid Tails (Hydrophobic)
            │
    [ Phosphate Group ]   ──► Esters to Choline Head ($-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{N}^+(\text{CH}_3)_3$) (Hydrophilic)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Triglycerides (Triacylglycerols)**: Esters of 1 molecule of Glycerol ($1,2,3$-trihydroxypropane) and 3 fatty acids linked by ester bonds.
• **Lecithin (Phosphatidylcholine)**: The predominant structural phospholipid of plasma membranes, consisting of a glycerol backbone esterified to two hydrophobic fatty acid chains, a phosphate group, and a positively charged **Choline** polar head.
• **Steroids & Cholesterol**: Possess a fused tetracyclic hydrocarbon core: the **Cyclopentanoperhydrophenanthrene (CPPP) ring** (17 carbons in 4 rings: A, B, C, D). **Cholesterol** modulates membrane fluidity and serves as the precursor for bile salts, vitamin D, and steroid hormones (cortisol, aldosterone, testosterone, estrogens).
